{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Compute the fraction of patients with SEVERE baseline disease
total_patients = len(df)
severe_patients = len(df[df['severity'] == 'severe'])
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients

# Print the fraction with exactly 3 decimal places to match the required precision
print(f'{fraction_severe:.3f}')"}
